backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko canister definition with an empty actor.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report describing two implemented features with referenced files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for various frontend source files used as reference documentation.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining Valentine-themed color variables, base styles, reduced-motion behavior, and a float animation.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file setting up the root element and loading the React entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring routes, theme provider, editable content provider, and global toaster.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedText.tsx: Component that animates text fade-in unless reduced‑motion is enabled.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationOverl: Temporary confetti heart overlay with fade-in/out animation, disabled for reduced-motion users.
frontend/src/components/Decorations.tsx: Renders decorative hearts or sparkles with optional motion depending on variant and user motion settings.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: App layout with gradient background, routed content outlet, footer attribution, and edit mode toggle.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: Empty placeholder file for the removed music player component.
frontend/src/components/PhotoGallery.tsx: Photo grid with a modal lightbox viewer supporting navigation and reduced‑motion handling.
Wrapper adding a fade/slide transition on route change unless reduced‑motion is enabled.
frontend/src/content/valentineContent.ts: Defines Valentine content schema and default content including recipient info, photos, letters, proposal, and celebration details.
frontend/src/editing/EditableContentProv: Context provider managing editable Valentine content, edit mode state, CRUD operations for letters and photos, and draft persistence.
frontend/src/editing/EditableText.tsx: Inline text editor component that switches between display and input modes based on edit mode, supporting single-line and multiline editing.
frontend/src/editing/EditModeToggle.tsx: Floating UI toggle to enter edit mode and open a dropdown with actions, including resetting content with a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/editing/imageSourceUtils.ts: Utility functions for validating image URLs and converting image files to data URLs with size and protocol checks.
frontend/src/editing/LettersEditor.tsx: UI for adding, editing, and deleting letters within the love note section, using dialogs for form input and confirmation.
frontend/src/editing/localDraftStorage.t: LocalStorage helpers for loading, saving, clearing, and resetting draft Valentine content with versioning.
frontend/src/editing/PhotoMemoriesEditor: Editor for managing photo entries with URL/file input validation, upload handling, and CRUD operations via dialogs.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login state and loading stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder hook returning an empty object since no backend queries are required.
frontend/src/hooks/useReducedMotion.ts: Detects the user's prefers-reduced-motion setting and returns a boolean reflecting it.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom Valentine-themed color variables, plus animations and reduced-motion handling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Sets up the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders App.
frontend/src/pages/CelebrationPage.tsx: Empty page file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/pages/FinalPage.tsx: Renders the final celebration page with animated text, icons, and an accordion of date activities based on valentineContent.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Displays the landing screen with decorations and editable text, leading to the photos page via a button.
frontend/src/pages/LoveNotePage.tsx: Shows animated love letters with optional editing tools and a button to proceed to the proposal step.
frontend/src/pages/PhotosMemoriesPage.ts: Displays editable photo memories and a gallery, with navigation to the love note page.
React page showing an editable proposal question with Yes/No buttons, where Yes navigates to /final and No moves unpredictably unless reduced motion is enabled.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config enabling dark mode, custom colors, fonts, animations, and extended Valentine-themed design tokens.
project_state.json: JSON tracking project metadata, feature requirements, and architectural notes for a customizable Valentine’s proposal website.
